title: Chunky
what: Loads the world ahead of time, so walking or flying into new land doesn't lag the server.
steps: Pick the world and how far out from the middle (0, 0) to load, then press Load the world ahead.
It takes a while and uses a lot of the PC's power. Best done when nobody is playing.
Pause stops it and keeps the progress; Continue picks it up again, also after a restart.

buttons.label: Load the world ahead
buttons.help: A square around 0, 0. The world gets bigger on disk.
buttons.warning: This adds land to the world files. It can't be undone without a backup.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.help: Stops for good. Land already loaded stays.
